market_definition: The spray adhesives market comprises adhesives packaged in aerosol cans or pressurised systems for fine, even application of temporary or permanent bonds. It measures sales of finished aerosol and bulk-spray adhesives regardless of base polymer. BY PACKAGING: Aerosol Cans, Pressurised Canisters & Bulk Spray Systems. BY BOND TYPE: Permanent, Repositionable, Temporary / Removable. BY CARRIER: Solvent-Borne, Water-Based. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Upholstery & Foam Bonding, Graphic Arts & Mounting, Automotive Interiors, Construction & Insulation, Arts, Crafts & Household, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Hand-brushed polychloroprene contact adhesives; pressure-sensitive hot melts; paints, coatings and cleaning aerosols. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
